{#- {{ shot(id="split-after", alt="…", caption="…", callouts=["Left half", "Right half"]) }}: a screenshot in both themes, rendered by the app (USER_DOCS.md §6.2). `focus` says where the action is, across; phones zoom there. Alt text is required: the build stops without it. `callouts` names controls the scene recorded in `.callouts.json` (their bounds, as fractions of the picture). They are drawn here as numbered markers, in the order given, and the steps refer to them with {{ callout(n=1) }}. A name the scene did not record stops the build; before the media is rendered the markers are left out. -#} {%- if not alt %}{{ throw(message="shot " ~ id ~ " needs alt text") }}{% endif -%} {%- set base = get_url(path="media/" ~ id) -%} {%- set names = callouts | default(value=[]) -%} {%- set bounds = load_data(path="static/media/" ~ id ~ ".callouts.json", required=false) -%}
